summary.text: Michelle Hennessee Sears is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 58 in the November 3, 2026 general election. A mental health professional, she describes herself as the owner of a small behavioral healthcare business.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Hennessee Sears graduated from Lake Central High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern Indiana in 2007 and a graduate degree from Ball State University in 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she holds a master's degree in Applied Behavior Analysis from Ball State and described herself as a wife, mother and small business owner.
Sears advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
She said she supports fiscal conservatism and social liberalism, firearm regulation and policy, and changes to the for-profit health insurance system.
She named healthcare reform, disability rights and programs, and the legalization and regulation of marijuana and hemp products as policy interests.
